description: This file is a shell script for testing the behavior of 'git add -u' command, creating various test scenarios to verify correct handling of file updates, deletions, untracked files, and other git operations within a repository.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a successful test case scenario, running the provided commands and expecting success.

methods.name: test_must_be_empty
methods.description: Verifies that the output of a command is empty.

methods.name: test_must_fail
methods.description: Checks that a command fails as expected.

methods.name: test_grep
methods.description: Searches for a pattern in command output.

methods.name: test_cmp
methods.description: Compares two files or outputs for differences.

methods.name: test_tick
methods.description: Advances the timestamp to simulate passage of time.

methods.name: test_ln_s_add
methods.description: Creates a symbolic link and stages it for git.

methods.name: test_done
methods.description: Marks the end of the test script.
